$comment: Ethereum mainnet. The endpoints are chosen for what this tape asks of them, which is eth_getLogs by topic with no contract address, and most public nodes refuse exactly that: PublicNode's HTTP wants an address, dRPC's free plan caps the range, 1RPC allows fifty blocks. Tenderly's public gateway and Flashbots both answer a two-thousand-block scan of the whole roster, so one is the endpoint and the other the fallback; PublicNode's socket takes the same topic-only subscription and is kept for that. Twelve-second blocks, so every block count in config/limits.json is about a hundred times longer here in wall-clock terms than on Robinhood Chain.
name: Ethereum
